newsitem.title: UK: Euro straight-run fuel poised for upturn.
newsitem.headline: Euro straight-run fuel poised for upturn.

text.p: European straight-run fuel oil was quiet on Monday because of public holidays but stronger crude had pricces poised for an upturn when business restarts, traders said.
Offer levels were notionally still around the $108-$109 fob a tonne level heard on Friday before crude began its 80 cent bull run but were expected to gain $3-$4 when sellers return to their desks.
One seller wondered how much buying support there would be for an upside.
But with refinery margins under severe pressure from crude's strength straight-run looked a very cheap alternative, traders said.
Russian fuel markets in the north were quiet with availability tight. But supplies were ample in the Mediterranean, where demand for good quality material was reported firm.
